content: FastAPI shared-secret auth standard pattern: fastapi.security.api_key.APIKeyHeader(auto_error=False) + a dependency function comparing header value against config secret using secrets.compare_digest (timing-safe), raised as HTTPException 401/403 on mismatch, applied via dependencies=[Depends(get_api_key)] on the router or per-route. API keys are the right default for machine/service clients over OAuth2 when there's a single operator.
